observations.description: Original 3D cartoon animation in the same character style: a moonlit samurai camp, soldiers, a commander and a rolling bomb.
Some very long continuous shots (10-13 s) with camera movement, unusual compared with the other references.
Time passing shown with an in-scene prop (a burning fuse coil) rather than an overlay.
Blue moonlit night palette; the climax is a full-frame explosion.
Captions show 1-2 words at a time in sentence case with punctuation kept; white heavy rounded sans-serif with a thin dark outline and soft shadow, centred just below the middle of the frame.
Builds tension around one object and ends on the explosion as the payoff.
Hook is a single concrete paradox stated immediately: "He rolled the bomb into the enemy camp, but made sure it wouldn't go off."
Ends on a concrete payoff that resolves the hook, no call to action: "And right as the biggest guy in camp lifts a hammer over his head, it finally reaches the powder."

categorical.hook_style: one-sentence concrete paradox (strange action, absurd consequence, or rule + contradiction), no intro
categorical.ending_style: concrete payoff image that resolves the hook, then the video stops (no CTA, no summary)
